primitives.name: Contextual Inference Overlay
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## TL;DR When a user is logged into DraftKings / FanDuel / BetMGM / Caesars and looking at a line on a Galaxy-tracked game, the extension renders a small Galaxy badge next to the line showing the Edge Index.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{\\text{edge}}': 'dimensionless Edge Index score', 'G': 'Galaxy-tracked game identifier', 'B': 'browser context object'}
primitives.assumptions: User is authenticated on supported sportsbook; game is tracked by Galaxy; DOM structure is stable enough for parsing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Live-line rendering with fallback to cached values when DOM mutation occurs.

layer2.mapping: The badge rendering function maps a parsed game state to a scalar Edge Index, isomorphic to GSI's posterior belief over game outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Badge visibility frequency and click-through rate on rendered indices.

primitives.name: DOM Game State Parser
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Extension behavior ### Game detection The extension runs a content script on supported sportsbook URLs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D': 'DOM node tree', 'M': 'Matchup metadata tuple', 'T': 'Time-stamped game state'}
primitives.assumptions: Sportsbook uses SPA architecture with frequent re-renders; DOM selectors are stable across versions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure detected via parser health API when mutation rate exceeds threshold.

layer2.mapping: Parser kernel extracts M from D and synchronizes T with live updates, forming input for GSE's state transition model.
layer2.telemetry: Parser success rate and DOM mutation count per page load.

primitives.name: Edge Index Injection
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every bet they're about to place gets contextualized by Galaxy's score before they click.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I_{\\text{badge}}': 'Badge injection point in DOM', 'S_{\\text{index}}': 'Scalar Edge Index value', 'U': 'User interaction event'}
primitives.assumptions: Badge does not interfere with sportsbook UI; index is computed within 30-second cache window.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Injection occurs on DOM ready and mutation events, with optional user toggle per book.

layer2.mapping: Badge injection mirrors GSE's policy update mechanism, where S_index becomes a contextual action signal.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of bets placed with visible badge vs. without.

The failure mode arises when DOM structures evolve unexpectedly, causing parser degradation—mitigated by health monitoring and alerting mechanisms.
